# gtree

> A macOS workspace for running several agents at once (works with Claude Code and Codex): see every agent’s status, get warned before two agents edit the same file, roll back changes turn by turn, and search past conversations.

gtree is a native macOS app (Apple Silicon) for developers who run several AI coding agents in parallel (Claude Code first), each in its own git worktree. Local features are free forever and need no sign-up; gtree never uploads your code. A paid Team plan is in development.
